title: Tetra Config (tetra.json)
description: Decisions an app makes about how Tetra behaves, committed with the app's code. Not for keys or secrets: every value here ends up in the JavaScript sent to browsers. An app lists only what differs from these defaults. Settings marked x-tetra-site can also be overridden for one site on the Configuration page, which then wins.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editors.

name.description: The app's name: page titles, the logo text and emails.

before.description: Text before the copyright year in the footer.

after.description: Text after the copyright year in the footer.

expiresDays.description: Days before a login session ends. Any activity restarts the clock.

passwordResetExpiresDays.description: Days a password reset link keeps working.

collapse.description: When the main menu (nav.site-menu) hides behind its menu button. auto: below the CSS breakpoint (--site-menu-breakpoint, 800px by default). always: on every screen, for a header that already holds a lot. never: always show the links.

longTitle.description: What gives way when the site header's title and its menu and icons don't fit on one row. wrap: the menu and icons drop below the title, together. truncate: the header stays one row and the title is cut short with an ellipsis.

indexable.description: Whether search engines may index the site at all. false (eg. a private tool like Work): every page says noindex and robots.txt disallows everything.

baseUrl.description: The site's address, eg. https://thyme.ariksavage.com (no trailing slash), for canonical and share URLs, so they never depend on the request. Empty: the request's own address. A local copy sets its own on the Configuration page.
baseUrl.x-tetra-label: Site address (for canonical and share links)

routes.description: The route map, from the app's root: which URLs are public pages and where their metadata comes from (see tetra/page-routes.schema.json). Read by the page renderer (PHP) and by Angular.

description.description: The site's description, for pages without their own: search results and link previews.

image.description: The default share image for link previews, a path from the site's root (eg. /favicon/web-app-manifest-512x512.png) or a full URL. A PNG or JPEG: most previews don't show SVG.

mode.description: add: these rules come after Tetra's (allow everything, disallow the route map's private pages). replace: they're the only rules, apart from the site's own and the sitemap link.

rules.description: robots.txt lines, eg. ["User-agent: GPTBot", "Disallow: /"]. A crawler obeys the group that names it, so a group for one crawler leaves the rest allowed. A site adds its own on the Configuration page (seo: Robots rules, Robots mode).
